subtitle: Softphone for Agent Workspace
micNeeded: Enable your microphone to receive calls
micFailed: Microphone unavailable. Check permissions in Chrome and try again.
audioBlocked: Chrome paused the call audio. Select Play call audio to hear the caller.
firstStep: Enable the microphone in this tab.
secondStep: Connect D-Phone and go available in Workspace.
thirdStep: Answer and end calls from Workspace.
keepOpen: Keep this D-Phone tab open while taking calls.

waiting.label: Waiting to connect
waiting.detail: Connect D-Phone from Agent Workspace when the microphone is ready.

connecting.label: Connecting
connecting.detail: D-Phone is getting ready for incoming calls.

ready.label: Phone ready
ready.detail: Go available in Workspace to receive calls.

active.label: On a call
active.detail: D-Phone carries the audio. End the call from Workspace.

lost.label: Connection lost
lost.detail: Check Workspace and try connecting D-Phone again.

duplicate.label: D-Phone is already open
duplicate.detail: Return to the existing D-Phone tab.
